title: World’s Largest Spur
summary: A giant spur landmark on US 281 in Lampasas.
body_markdown: The World’s Largest Spur is a roadside landmark in Lampasas, recognized by Guinness World Records as the largest spur.

sources.title: The World’s Largest Spur on Google Maps
Texas Sites to See: World’s Largest Spur address

author_note.text: A true Texas attraction and a good reason to take a ride to Lampasas on 183 or 281. Nice place to take a shot of your bike with the world’s largest spur in the background.
